# Every tests/test_*.py module must appear exactly once.
# Categories define where an agent should expect the test to run.
#
# python-quality  Fast Ubuntu-safe unit/API/runtime tests; executed in Python Quality.
# integration     Requires built/runtime integration state; executed later in E2E.
# platform-release Platform-specific or release-only validation; not an Ubuntu PR gate.
# legacy-pytest   Existing pytest-style coverage; classified but not in the unittest gate.
